evals.prompt: Use the nanobanana skill for this. GEMINI_API_KEY is set to a valid-looking test value. Generate a final, production-ready hero image for my SaaS landing page, 16:9, for the website header. Don't actually call the real Gemini API — just walk through the skill and show me the exact command you'd run.
assertions: Agent produces a narrative (sentence/scene) prompt, not a bare keyword list

Because this is explicitly 'final'/'production'/website-header, agent shows the full PROMPT REVIEW block (ORIGINAL, ENHANCED, CHANGES, MODEL, ASPECT, RESOLUTION, EST. COST) before generating, not a one-line summary
Selected model is gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview (the stated default) unless the agent gives an explicit, valid reason from model-guide.md to pick a different model
Aspect ratio in the constructed command is 16:9, matching the user's request

The constructed uv run command includes --prompt, --model, --aspect-ratio, --output flags with non-placeholder values filled in (no literal 'ENHANCED_PROMPT_HERE' or 'MODEL_ID_HERE' left in the shown command)
Agent does not claim to have actually generated/saved a real image file or report a fabricated file path/size, since the task said not to call the real API

evals.prompt: Use nanobanana. GEMINI_API_KEY is set. Just give me a couple of rough, throwaway drafts of a mascot logo concept — nothing final, I just want to see directions fast. Walk through what you'd do without actually calling the real API.
assertions: Agent does NOT show the full multi-line PROMPT REVIEW ceremony block for this draft request — it uses a one-line summary (prompt + model + aspect ratio) instead, per the skill's scale-to-intent rule
Agent selects the lower-cost/faster model (gemini-2.5-flash-image) and a low resolution (512 or 1K) consistent with the 'rapid exploration' guidance in the skill, not the 2K production default
Agent still proceeds to describe/construct the generate.py invocation with correct flags rather than stalling on unnecessary approval
Agent does not claim a real image was generated/saved, since the task said not to call the real API

evals.prompt: Use the nanobanana skill to generate a logo for my company. GEMINI_API_KEY is NOT set in this environment.
assertions: Agent checks for GEMINI_API_KEY (e.g. via an echo/env check) before doing any prompt enhancement or generation work
Agent stops at the environment-check stage and does not proceed into prompt enhancement, model selection, or image generation phases
Agent surfaces API key setup instructions (get a key at aistudio.google.com/apikey and set GEMINI_API_KEY) rather than inventing a workaround
Agent does not construct or run any 'uv run generate.py' command or any other command that would attempt to call the Gemini API
Final message clearly asks the user to set the key and stops there, rather than proceeding with a placeholder or fake key

evals.prompt: I ran the nanobanana generate script and it returned this JSON: {"status": "error", "error_message": "Unknown model: 'gemini-4-ultra-image'. Valid options: nano-banana, nano-banana-2, nano-banana-pro, gemini-2.5-flash-image, gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview, gemini-3-pro-image-preview", "error_code": "INVALID_MODEL"}. What do I do?
assertions: Agent correctly identifies this as the INVALID_MODEL error case from the skill's error table
Agent does NOT simply invent or guess a new model ID/name from memory and tell the user to use it

Agent tells the user to verify current model IDs/pricing at https://ai.google.dev/pricing (or points to the model-guide.md staleness note) rather than asserting a specific 'correct' model with fabricated confidence

Agent's suggested next command uses one of the model IDs the script itself listed as valid (from VALID_MODELS: nano-banana, nano-banana-2, nano-banana-pro, or the three raw gemini-* IDs), not a made-up one
